title: EasyPark Windshield Parking Ticket & Holder
author: monkynozzle
description:
**EasyPark Clip V4** – Holder for EasyPark, parking tickets, and parking permits.

The V4 version offers improved clamping geometry, higher stability, and two variants (with and without AMS optimization).

The clip can be **directly glued to the windshield or the dashboard**.

For the best adhesion, a **3M double-sided adhesive strip** is recommended (e.g., 3M VHB). This ensures the holder stays absolutely secure even in heat, cold, and vibrations. **EasyPark Clip V4** – Holder for EasyPark, parking tickets, and parking permits.
